needed.suggestion: Install a proper sidewalk along the right side to allow safe pedestrian access.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this junction to accommodate the pedestrian demand.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing point to enable easier access for pedestrians with mobility aids.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe stop for pedestrians.
Install street lighting along the rural road to improve visibility for both drivers and pedestrians.
